name: story-slides-monorepo
description: Tap-to-advance story slides (StoryDeck) and graded flashcard/quiz decks (CardDeck) for React, with a shareable deck protocol (URL-based DeckManifest + file-based ShareableDeck compatible with the Swift SDK).

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=story-slides-protocol && npm run typecheck --workspace=story-slides-ui
